pages.title: Functor Bridge
pages.text: A map between categories that sends objects to objects and arrows to arrows while respecting composition. It lets you translate a hard problem in one area of mathematics into an easier one elsewhere. The bridge is narrow, sturdy and arched in a way that suggests symmetry.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed a structured way to pass from a category to a manifold to the octonions. The Formal Proof Assistant found a functor that carried every arrow over without breaking a composition.
